name: Youth On The Move (NGO)
description:
Youth On The Move is a youth-driven, nation-building NGO committed to creating real and lasting impact. Founded by passionate young individuals at just 17, the organization thrives on the selfless contributions of its members, who volunteer their time and donate from their own salaries.

Join us in shaping a brighter future, where every effort counts and every contribution creates meaningful impact.

featured_reviews.name: Samit Salian
featured_reviews.review_text: Residents of Aarey have been suffering since years now & finally when there is some sign of repairs being done you are protesting against the same ??? Have you ever travelled by these roads ? Besides the residents there are other citizens also who use this road to avoid the highway. The roads being repaired are the only way for us to travel to Goregaon / Malad. There are kids travelling to school & senior citizens travelling as well. Just imagine a person travelling on these pothole roads in case of a medical emergency which is always our nightmare. Its very easy to make statements without actually seeing the plight of the people staying there or even seeing the condition of the roads. We are tax paying citizens & access to good roads is our right which is correctly accepted by the government officials as well. Request you all to please visit Aarey, see the condition of the roads & then comment if you are truly worried about betterment of society.

इस पावन अवसर पर महाशिवरात्रि के दिन आइए याद रखें —
“हर जीव में शिव बसते हैं।”

भगवान शिव हमें करुणा, दया और हर प्राणी के प्रति सम्मान का संदेश देते हैं।
इस दिन को केवल पूजा तक सीमित न रखें, बल्कि पशुओं और प्रकृति के प्रति प्रेम और सेवा के कार्यों से भी मनाएँ।

आइए संरक्षण करें, सेवा करें और स्नेह दें — क्योंकि हर जीवन में ईश्वर का वास है। 🐾

आप सभी को महाशिवरात्रि की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएँ।

या पवित्र महाशिवरात्रीच्या दिवशी आपण लक्षात ठेवूया —
“प्रत्येक जीवामध्ये शिव वास करतात.”

भगवान शिव आपल्याला करुणा, दया आणि प्रत्येक सजीवाप्रती आदर ठेवण्याचा संदेश देतात.
ही शिवरात्र फक्त पूजा करूनच नाही, तर प्राणी आणि निसर्गाविषयी प्रेम व सेवाभावाने साजरी करूया.

चला संरक्षण करूया, सेवा करूया आणि माया देऊया — कारण प्रत्येक जीवामध्ये ईश्वर आहे. 🐾

आपणा सर्वांना महाशिवरात्रीच्या हार्दिक शुभेच्छा.

featured_reviews.review_text:
The commitment and influence of the Utkarsh Global Foundation really amaze me. Their work is both professional and compassionate, ranging from setting up extensive animal welfare initiatives like the Animal Welfare Fortnight to opening a fully operational animal hospital in various parts of Maharashtra.

In both urban and rural Maharashtra, their programs—which include pet adoption drives, anti-rabies vaccination camps, tree planting, and educational outreach in schools—are having a significant impact.

Their dedication to cooperation—working with volunteers, schools, the police, and local authorities to effect long-lasting change—is what truly makes them stand out. The group, under the direction of Adv. Dagdu Ravsaheb Londhe, is fervent, open, and genuinely committed to improving both the lives of people and animals.

If you have a strong interest in animals, I strongly suggest volunteering or contributing to the Utkarsh Global Foundation.

“GDF has truly been a blessing for the animal community. Their dedication towards the welfare of community animals is genuinely commendable. From providing free and affordable vaccinations to offering low-cost medical assistance, they have made it much easier for people who care for stray and community animals to ensure they receive proper healthcare.

What stands out the most is their consistent effort to support animals that often go unnoticed. Their food program is also a wonderful initiative, helping ensure that many animals do not go hungry and receive the nourishment they need. Initiatives like these make a real difference on the ground and inspire more people to contribute to animal welfare.

Organizations like GDF are doing truly meaningful work, and their efforts deserve recognition and support. The compassion, dedication, and service they provide to the animal community are deeply appreciated.
